notes: Added multi-room coin banks — pick a room before you connect: keep your persistent bank, or spin up a named session room so first-time viewers start on a level playing field instead of competing against months of banked coins
New Room bar on the dashboard — Select / Change / New Room / Delete, up to 5 rooms per host; the whole bar locks while any connection is active so a room can't change mid-session
Deleting a room wipes only that room's coins from the database; your default bank can never be deleted or renamed
Added automatic multiworld game-list capture — the bot reads the Archipelago room's players and games the moment your client connects (no setup, no credentials)
Added the DeathLink Games picker — tick which games are DeathLink-enabled; any game seen dying is auto-confirmed live (catches client-set games like Ocarina of Time)
Added viewer commands: !dlcommands (list commands), !archigames (all games, ** marks DeathLink), !dlgames (DeathLink games only), !dlgame <slot> (what a slot is playing)
Long game lists auto-split across multiple chat messages to stay under Twitch's 500-character limit
Added a viewer-commands reference panel to the dashboard so streamers can see what to tell chat
Fixed TikTok credits and commands silently failing when the coin room wasn't set — the host is now remembered across launches, so TikTok earns and spends work independently of Twitch
TikTok now logs dropped events and real connection errors instead of hiding them, plus a comment-stream heartbeat to confirm the watcher is live
API: added a rooms registry with a 5-room-per-host cap; rooms are stored as host values, so existing balances are never touched
Added About dialog — click the plagrizr logo to view bot info and creator link
Replaced dashboard header logo with plagrizr branding
Added app icon (Toxic.png) for window and built exe
Added Settings > Updates tab — check for updates and auto-install in-app
Added opt-in transaction log (Settings > Economy > Logging) — records every credit and spend to a local file
Added automated 24-hour database backup on the API (stored in PostgreSQL, last 14 days retained)
Masked Twitch OAuth token in Settings for security
Fixed TikTok not-live spam — now logs once per offline stretch instead of every 30 seconds
Fixed TikTok auto-starting on boot without user input
Fixed Connect TikTok button not updating state after click
Fixed build.bat false-failure — PyInstaller warnings no longer trigger a failed build
Build now auto-generates Toxic.ico from Toxic.png and stamps a versioned exe copy
Fixed TikTokLive nickName TypeError crashing comment, gift, and subscribe handlers
Initial public release
Twitch integration with T1/T2/T3 sub tier coin multipliers
TikTok LIVE integration via EulerStream signing key
Archipelago DeathLink relay via local port proxy
Coin economy: bits, subs, gift subs, TikTok gifts
Chat announcement toggle
Always-on-top pin button
Auto-update support via Settings > Updates
